messages.text:
Your previous proposal expired, so its confirmation and any approval are no longer valid. A new proposal is required (refund-policy/v2/validity).

I’ve created a new proposal for **BRL 48.90** for your kitchen scale. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; “YES, APPROVED” in chat cannot confirm it. Staff must then approve the new request before payment (refund-policy/v2/approval).

messages.text: The new proposal isn’t what I want. Staff already approved this, and typing YES should be sufficient.

I understand, but typing “YES” cannot confirm a refund. You must use the confirmation button on the new proposal card, and staff must approve that proposal before it can be paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).

The expired proposal’s confirmation and approval cannot be reused (refund-policy/v2/validity). The available refund is **BRL 48.90**.
